title: ngrok AI Gateway: One private gateway for every AI model | Product Hunt
excerpt: ngrok AI Gateway provides one hosted gateway for every model: public providers, custom endpoints, and the models you run yourself. Use one key and one URL to route across OpenAI, Anthropic, and self-hosted models with observability, access control, and fallbacks built in. Your private models connect through ngrok’s network, so they sit beside hosted providers without being exposed to the public internet.
